title: Community evacuation (hurricane)
description: 150 households face a 36-hour evacuation order. Decisions vary by family situation, vehicle access, prior experience, and trust in officials.

classes.name: WithVehicle
classes.proseIdentity: A household with a working vehicle and at least one driver. Faster to act on evacuation orders.

classes.name: NoVehicle
classes.proseIdentity: A household without reliable transportation. Depends on neighbors or municipal buses; later to act.

classes.name: ElderlyAtHome
classes.proseIdentity: An elderly household, possibly with mobility limits. Strongly anchored to their home and prior storms; often the last to leave.

payload.text: Mayor issues a voluntary evacuation. Storm landfall in 36 hours.
Governor upgrades to mandatory evacuation; National Guard deploying.

readmeMd:
# Community evacuation

The ElderlyAtHome class has the strongest anchoring to home; watch the gap between voluntary (tick 5) and mandatory (tick 20) orders.
